findings.title: Locale-to-English resolution does not support valid locale suffixes
findings.body: The suffix regex only accepts letters and underscores. Valid resource-bundle locale names containing a numeric region or hyphen, such as `messages_es_419.properties`, are not rewritten to `_en.properties`. For a translated bundle under `resources-community`, verification then tries to open a nonexistent `resources/.../messages_es_419.properties` and aborts; where a same-named file does exist, it is incorrectly used as its own English baseline. Extract the locale suffix without restricting it to this character set before resolving the English bundle.

findings.title: Account UI message was changed to unsupported MessageFormat syntax
findings.body: This account-ui bundle uses the React/i18next interpolation convention (`{{0}}`, `{{username}}`) throughout. Replacing this message with Java `MessageFormat` placeholders and a `choice` expression means the UI will not interpolate the attribute/min/max values or evaluate the plural choice; users will see literal `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2,choice,...}` text when this validation error is displayed.

findings.title: Admin UI validation message uses Java formatting instead of UI interpolation
findings.body: The admin UI resource previously used `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}`, matching the UI localization engine's interpolation syntax. The new single-brace Java `MessageFormat`/`choice` expression is not evaluated by that engine, so the multivalued-attribute validation error will render its placeholders and choice expression literally rather than showing the supplied values.

findings.title: Lithuanian account TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `messages_lt.properties` now contains `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian rather than Lithuanian. Lithuanian account-console users will receive an unrelated-language instruction during TOTP setup.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian login bundle now sets `loginTotpStep1` to the Italian sentence `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`. This makes the first TOTP setup instruction appear in the wrong language on the Lithuanian login flow.

findings.title: Simplified-Chinese bundle now contains Traditional-Chinese text
findings.body: The `zh_CN` resource is a Simplified Chinese bundle, but the replacement uses Traditional Chinese characters and wording (`手機`, `安裝`, `應用程式`). This is inconsistent with the rest of the bundle and presents the account TOTP instruction in the wrong script for the China locale.
